messages:
jane_support: customer reported a sudden surge of 5xx + timeouts in euw1 since ~09:43 UTC. Ticket INC-12345. sample req ids: req_9a8b, req_9a8c. They saw p99 jump and many client timeouts.

sre_bot: ALERT: SLO_BURN hosted-inference.euw1.gateway p99_errors > 2% (5m window). Pager window opened.

maria_g: acknowledged. pulling euw1 gateway dashboard now -> https://console.redwood/infer/dashboards/euw1-gateway. p99_errors graph shows sharp spike starting 09:42:30. @kevin_s can you run a quick logs query for /v1/generate and upstream timeouts?

kevin_s: running quick elk query, returning counts. query I used:
```
index=prod-logs service=gateway region=euw1 route=/v1/generate | stats count() by status, upstream_pool
```
result (last 5m): 5xx=420 (baseline ~12), 502/504 dominant, upstream_pool=rt-euw1-03 most affected (~78%).

alex_r: checking traces — looks like sparse traces around the spike. span sampling + collector egress shows ~40% missing spans for those req ids. possible trace ingestion pressure or egress network flaps.

maria_g: ok. mitigation plan: 1) enable route fallback to smaller model for euw1 for 15m, 2) scale up runtime pool rt-euw1-03 by +2 nodes, 3) keep tracing sampling at 100% for 10m to capture repro. I'll apply routing change now.

maria_g: applying fallback policy patch:
```
PATCH /v1/policies/fallback
{
  "region": "euw1",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "fallback_model": "redwood/model-small-v1",
  "duration": "15m"
}
```

kevin_s: autoscaler request sent to infra: scale(rt-euw1-03, +2) -> scaling started 09:49 UTC, nodes provisioning.

kevin_s: re-ran logs after routing change (09:50-09:53): 5xx dropped to 18 in 3m window. latency p99 reduced. looks like fallback helped.

jane_support: relayed to customer — they see error rate back to normal for their checks. customer asked for root cause analysis and timeline.

alex_r: follow-up: need deeper dive on trace ingestion gaps and upstream worker saturation on rt-euw1-03. create investigation ticket to check collector egress logs and node-level OOMs/cpu.

maria_g: created infra investigation ticket: INF-7892, assigned to alex_r. also adding a short runbook entry for temporary fallback steps and auto-rollback criteria.

sre_bot: Incident created: INC-12345-euw1-5xx-burst. Severity: P2. Links: https://inc.redwood/INC-12345, https://infra.redwood/INF-7892

maria_g: action items: (1) alex_r to investigate trace gaps + node metrics (INF-7892), (2) kevin_s to validate autoscaler logs and node health, (3) support to send RCA timeline to customer once INF-7892 has findings. I'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
